title: Homology coordinates of the raw derived tensor arrow
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A,B and an (A tensor_R B)-algebra structure on D, sheaf derived categories and module derived categories over R,B. Let M be any unbounded complex of A-modules, m any BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], and phi:A→D and psi:B→D the specified restrictions of alpha:A tensor_R B→D. For each integer i, put j:B→A tensor_R B, C=D tensor_A M formed with alpha restricted to A, and Cg=D tensor_{A,phi} M. Let cE=m.comparison(i) followed by H^i(m.ordinaryToLocalized) and the exact restriction homology comparison; let s=res_j(cE) followed by rho.inv on H^i(C), where rho is the identity-on-carriers scalar comparison res_psi≅res_j res_alpha. Let z0:H^i(C)→H^i(Cg) be equality transport. Let kappa be tilde(m.cohomologyIso(i)) followed by the natural exact-tilde derived homology isomorphism. For the actual raw derived arrow r [lem-pc-affine-tilde-derived-tensor-mate], kappa.hom followed by H^i(r) equals tilde(s) followed by tilde(res_psi(z0)) followed by affineTildePushforwardCohomologyMap D B psi Cg i [lem-pc-affine-tilde-pushforward-cohomology-normalization]. No geometric base-change mate, K-flatness, quasi-coherence, pullback counit or target representative occurs.

proof.text: Use the kernel-checked source and raw-arrow defining equations to express kappa as tilde of m.cohomologyIso followed by exact-derived homology comparison, and r as exact-derived tilde of the module-model counit, the Q factor, and the ordinary target map. Exact-derived homology naturality moves the counit to module homology. Use the Q/homology formula at the ordinary extension complex.

Ordinary complex homology naturality moves the coefficient chain map across exact tilde. Rewrite the homotopy homology factor as the complex factor and substitute m.comparison_eq. The private coefficientHomology calculation uses restriction naturality, the shared inverse composite comparison from affineTildePushforwardHomologyFactorization, and ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans for the scalar natural isomorphism. Homology of the equality transport is z0. Apply the proved affineTildeCoefficientPushforwardHomologyCoordinates for the remaining ordinary pushforward map and derived unit; distribute functors and reassociate.

theorem affineTildeDerivedTensorToPushforward_homology
    (R A B D : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (m : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D)
    (φ : A →+* D) (ψ : B →+* D)
    (hφ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)) = φ)
    (hψ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = ψ) (i : ℤ) :
    let α := algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D
    let j : B →+* A ⊗[R] B := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
    let T := tilde.functor (.of B)
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i
    let C := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (α.comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let Cg := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let cE := m.comparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap m.ordinaryToLocalized i ≫
      ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α)).hom
    let ρ := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp' j α ψ hψ.symm
    let s := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map cE ≫ ρ.inv.app (C.homology i)
    let z₀ := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} D) (.up ℤ) i).map
      (eqToHom (by dsimp only [C, α]; rw [hφ] : C = Cg))
    (affineTildeDerivedTensorSourceIso R A B D M m i).hom ≫
        H.map (affineTildeDerivedTensorToPushforward R A B D M m φ ψ hφ hψ) =
      T.map s ≫ T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ).map z₀) ≫
        affineTildePushforwardCohomologyMap D B ψ Cg i
